Media, gaming and night-first products.
Pink in Nunito Sans with generous corners — the friendliest thing in the set without becoming a toy.
Education, non-profits and family-facing brands.
Lime in monospace, compact, hairline ring, flat surfaces and the sharpest corners of all fifteen.

%d presets, one set of content

Every card below is rendered live in the preset it names — same components, same markup, only different tokens. Switching a preset repaints the site and never touches a word of content. Switch this page to dark mode and all %d cards switch with it: each preset ships its own dark token set.
What actually differs
Type, corner radius, control density, focus-ring width and elevation. Colour is only part of what a preset decides.

%d of the presets come from the create page on ui.shadcn.com and %d are house presets generated against WCAG 2.2 contrast targets. Set one for a whole site with desiderio.shadcn.preset in the site settings, or for one page and everything below it with the Theme preset field in the page properties — it is inherited down the rootline, so a campaign subtree can run a different look inside the same install. Neither needs a rebuild: the tokens are runtime CSS custom properties. Anything you design on the create page yourself goes in as custom.
